span.p:
Relational Database (Neon Serverless PostgreSQL 16)
• PgBouncer TLS 1.3 Multiplexing (Port 6543)
• Unprivileged bbt_app role (NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS)
• FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on all tenant tables
• Hardened SECURITY DEFINER (pinned pg_catalog search_path)
• Append-Only Dual Hash-Chained Audit Ledger (row_hash & report_chain_hash)

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Object Storage (Cloudflare R2 Distributed Bucket)
• S3-Compatible Object Store (SSE-R2 AES-256 at rest)
• Client-Encrypted RFC 9580 SEIPDv2 Binary PoCs
• Time-Limited Presigned S3 URLs (15-Minute Reservation Lease)
• Direct Browser S3 PUT / GET (Zero Server Memory Proxying)
• Zero Bandwidth Egress Fees (Academic & Commercial Cost Predictability)
